biggest_catch: Mission availability is thin and irregular — some regions see only a handful of missions per week, so treat it as occasional beer money, not steady work.
catches: Mission density varies wildly by city/country; some users see very few missions.
Rewards are credited to your in-app wallet after BeMyEye's team approves the mission — no pay for rejected missions.
Higher levels unlock more missions, so new users see the thinnest pickings.

steps: Download the BeMyEye app and register (18+).
Browse missions on the map; each shows its reward before you book.
Go to the location and complete the mission (photos, questions, mystery shop, home surveys).
BeMyEye's team approves the submission; rewards are credited to your wallet.
Transfer the cash to your bank account or PayPal.
timing: Rewards credited to your in-app wallet after mission approval, then transferable to your bank account or PayPal.
who_pays: BeMyEye pays you per completed mission — rewards land in your in-app wallet.
who_qualifies: 18+; a smartphone; available in select, Europe-weighted markets.
work_available: Thin and irregular — mission density varies wildly by city and country, and new users see the thinnest pickings (higher levels unlock more missions). Treat it as occasional beer money.
what_gets_accepted: BeMyEye's team must approve the mission for you to earn; rejected missions earn nothing.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: travel to mission locations and any rejected mission.
when_cash_arrives: Rewards are credited to your in-app wallet after mission approval, then you can transfer them to your bank account or PayPal.

repeatable.cadence: New missions post around you — complete a mission, get approved, rewards credit to your wallet, and take the next one.

reject_reason: offline/in-person — catalog is online-only per owner 2026-09-23
